notes: Modified competition rules (section 5.2): shot clock should not be introduced until U14; quarters referenced for substitutions; 5v5 full-court format allowed alongside 3x3/4x4; scoring modifications optional. Period length is competition-local; declarative rules use FIBA Art. 8.1 10-minute quarters as parent baseline when a mini competition elects standard quarter structure.
